issue_request: FHIR-19465 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Coverage and asked for Coverage.status, Coverage.beneficiary, and Coverage.costToBeneficiary.type to be 1..1 and Coverage.payor to be 1..*.

additional_context: Coverage is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source already had status and beneficiary at 1..1. Later costToBeneficiary issues FHIR-32966 and FHIR-27024 added qualifiers and optional value/exception behavior without reversing the requirement that a cost entry identify its type.
